scope: Internal sequential Default AllowProperties parsed-condition cache
representation: Per named-module classloader static synchronized exact raw string to immutable AST. Parse and warning emission only on reached cache miss. No evaluation context, value, globals, owner path or State retained. Evaluation outside lock.
